Deployment.description: Deployment 元数据注解。生产上常用于记录变更原因、配置版本、Git 提交号或 checksum/config，以便在 ConfigMap/Secret 变更时自动触发滚动发布。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "release 2026-03-28 build 1186"
    checksum/config: "2a5cb9e0c6f4d8a1738b4d45d9f0c8a1"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service

Deployment.description: 无状态微服务的副本数。生产环境不建议只保留 1 个副本，通常至少 3 个副本起步，再结合 HPA 在流量高峰自动扩容，从而同时满足滚动发布、节点维护与故障转移。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: commerce
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080

Deployment.description: 最小就绪时间。新 Pod 连续 Ready 达到该秒数后才会被视为可用副本，适合需要缓存预热、连接池建连或服务注册传播时间的微服务。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 4
  minReadySeconds: 30
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service

Deployment.description: 保留历史 ReplicaSet 数量。生产建议保留足够的回滚版本，一般为 5 到 10；过大则会增加控制平面对象数量与认知负担。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service

Deployment.description: Deployment 发布推进超时。若滚动更新在指定时间内仍无法完成，控制器会标记进度失败，便于告警系统和发布平台及时终止异常发布。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 600
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service

Deployment.description: Deployment 的滚动发布策略。生产建议使用 RollingUpdate，并将 maxUnavailable 设为 0 或较小值，保证升级期间服务可用；maxSurge 用于平滑新增实例，避免一次性拉起过多 Pod 挤爆节点资源。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 4
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 25%
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: Pod 使用的 ServiceAccount。生产不建议直接使用 default 账号，应该为需要访问 K8s API、云存储、消息系统的服务绑定最小权限账号。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: order-service-sa
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: 私有镜像仓库凭据引用。生产集群通常接入企业 Harbor、ACR、ECR 或私有制品库，建议统一创建命名规范的 dockerconfigjson Secret，并通过 imagePullSecrets 注入，避免在镜像拉取阶段失败。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: regcred-prod
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

Deployment.description: 简单节点标签选择器。适合把微服务固定在 application 节点池、特定 CPU 架构或合规节点上；如果策略更复杂，再升级为 nodeAffinity。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        nodepool: application
        kubernetes.io/arch: amd64
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: 容忍带污点的节点。生产常与 dedicated 节点池配合，把核心业务、计算密集型任务或中间件固定到专用节点，避免与杂项工作负载互相抢占资源。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      tolerations:
        - key: "dedicated"
          operator: "Equal"
          value: "application"
          effect: "NoSchedule"
      nodeSelector:
        nodepool: application
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: 节点亲和性用于把业务工作负载调度到指定节点池，例如 application 节点池、SSD 节点或特定可用区。生产上常用 requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution 做硬约束，再配合 preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution 做软偏好。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      affinity:
        nodeAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            nodeSelectorTerms:
              - matchExpressions:
                  - key: nodepool
                    operator: In
                    values:
                      - application
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 80
              preference:
                matchExpressions:
                  - key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
                    operator: In
                    values:
                      - ap-southeast-1a
                      - ap-southeast-1b
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: Pod 反亲和性用于避免相同微服务副本扎堆到同一主机或同一可用区。对面向外部流量的核心服务，建议至少按 hostname 打散，跨可用区场景再增加 zone 维度，降低单机或单 AZ 故障带来的容量损失。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            - weight: 90
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
                topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: 拓扑打散约束可在 zone、hostname 等拓扑域内保持副本均衡。对大促、高并发入口服务很重要，因为它比单纯的反亲和性更容易量化容量分布，避免某个节点或某个 AZ 过热。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 6
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: Pod 级安全上下文。用于统一设定 runAsUser、runAsGroup、fsGroup 等参数，适合需要共享卷权限控制或统一非 root 运行策略的微服务。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: file-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: file-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: file-service
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
      containers:
        - name: file-service
          image: registry.example.com/content/file-service:5.2.0

Deployment.description: Pod 共享卷文件组。对于需要多个进程共同访问挂载卷、且卷内文件权限受组控制的场景，fsGroup 是最常见的生产做法。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: file-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: file-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: file-service
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
      containers:
        - name: file-service
          image: registry.example.com/content/file-service:5.2.0

Deployment.description: Pod 的 DNS 策略。普通业务 Pod 通常保持 ClusterFirst；若启用了 hostNetwork，则多数情况下需要切换到 ClusterFirstWithHostNet，避免解析异常。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: edge-agent
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-agent
    spec:
      hostNetwork: true
      dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet
      containers:
        - name: edge-agent
          image: registry.example.com/platform/edge-agent:2.3.1

Deployment.description: 是否使用宿主机网络。仅适合边缘网关、网络代理、主机级采集器等少数场景；普通微服务启用后会增加端口冲突和安全隔离复杂度。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: edge-gateway
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-gateway
    spec:
      hostNetwork: true
      dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet
      containers:
        - name: edge-gateway
          image: registry.example.com/platform/edge-gateway:3.1.0

Deployment.description: Pod 优先级类。适用于支付、订单、网关等关键链路微服务，在集群资源紧张时可以优先获得调度和保留能力，但应谨慎使用，避免全员“高优先级”。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      priorityClassName: app-critical
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6

Deployment.description: 为 Pod 追加静态 hosts 记录。生产上尽量优先使用 DNS 服务发现，仅在兼容遗留系统、外部固定地址或临时迁移阶段才建议使用 hostAliases。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: report-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
    spec:
      hostAliases:
        - ip: "10.10.20.30"
          hostnames:
            - "legacy-report-db.internal"
      containers:
        - name: report-service
          image: registry.example.com/report/report-service:4.6.1

Deployment.description: 自定义 DNS 解析配置。仅在默认集群 DNS 不能满足要求时使用，例如需要附加搜索域、备用 nameserver 或 resolver options；滥用会增加运维复杂度。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: report-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
    spec:
      dnsPolicy: ClusterFirst
      dnsConfig:
        options:
          - name: ndots
            value: "2"
      containers:
        - name: report-service
          image: registry.example.com/report/report-service:4.6.1

Deployment.description: 覆盖镜像默认 ENTRYPOINT。生产上只有在需要注入启动前脚本、等待依赖、动态生成配置或兼容遗留镜像时才建议覆盖 command。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: report-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: report-service
          image: registry.example.com/report/report-service:4.6.1
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c

Deployment.description: 覆盖镜像默认 CMD。适合通过参数注入 JVM 启动逻辑、动态 profile 或包装后的启动脚本，优点是无需重建镜像即可在发布层调整运行参数。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: report-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: report-service
          image: registry.example.com/report/report-service:4.6.1
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
          args:
            - java ${JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS} -jar /app/report-service.jar --spring.profiles.active=prod

Deployment.description: 环境变量动态取值。常见来源包括 fieldRef（Pod IP、命名空间）、resourceFieldRef（资源限制）、configMapKeyRef 和 secretKeyRef，适合避免把运行时上下文写死在镜像里。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace

Deployment.description: 从 Pod 自身字段读取环境变量。生产上最常见的是注入 `status.podIP`、`metadata.namespace`、`metadata.name` 等运行时上下文，避免应用通过 API 再次查询自身元数据。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name

Deployment.description: 从容器资源限制中读取值。适合把 CPU 或内存限制注入应用，用于动态计算线程池、堆大小或缓存容量，避免配置与资源配额脱节。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: account-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: account-service
          image: registry.example.com/iam/account-service:2.4.8
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 2Gi
          env:
            - name: CONTAINER_MEMORY_LIMIT
              valueFrom:
                resourceFieldRef:
                  containerName: account-service
                  resource: limits.memory

Deployment.description: 批量引入 ConfigMap 与 Secret 的环境变量。适合管理数据库地址、线程池、日志级别等多项配置，但建议把强约束、必须存在的关键变量改为显式 env，以便在字段级别进行审计和变更管理。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: order-service-config
            - secretRef:
                name: order-service-secret

Deployment.description: 给 envFrom 批量导入的变量统一加前缀。适合把公共配置按模块做命名空间隔离，避免多个 ConfigMap/Secret 键名冲突。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          envFrom:
            - prefix: APP_
              configMapRef:
                name: order-service-config

Deployment.description: 容器资源请求与限制。针对 JVM 微服务，建议 requests 与 limits 保持一致以获得 Guaranteed QoS，并配合 JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS 中的 -XX:MaxRAMPercentage 控制堆内存占比，避免容器内存已到上限时发生 OOMKilled。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          env:
            - name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
              value: '-XX:+UseContainerSupport -XX:InitialRAMPercentage=50.0 -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=70.0 -XX:MinRAMPercentage=50.0'
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 2Gi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 2Gi

Deployment.description: 只挂载卷中的单个文件或子目录。生产上很适合把 `application.yml`、`logback-spring.xml`、证书链等单个文件映射到固定路径，而不覆盖整个目录。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      volumes:
        - name: app-config
          configMap:
            name: order-service-config
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          volumeMounts:
            - name: app-config
              mountPath: /app/config/application.yml
              subPath: application.yml
              readOnly: true

Deployment.description: 优雅停机钩子。对于接入注册中心、消息消费者或长连接的微服务，建议在 preStop 中预留注销与连接排空时间，并将 terminationGracePeriodSeconds 设置得比 sleep 更长，避免正在处理的请求被强制中断。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command:
                  - /bin/sh
                  - -c
                  - sleep 25

Deployment.description: 容器启动后立即执行的钩子。适合执行缓存预热、目录初始化、证书复制或 sidecar 注册动作，但要确保逻辑短小且幂等，避免拖慢 Ready 时间。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: report-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: report-service
          image: registry.example.com/report/report-service:4.6.1
          lifecycle:
            postStart:
              exec:
                command:
                  - /bin/sh
                  - -c
                  - mkdir -p /app/work && echo warmup-ready

Deployment.description: 启动探针适合启动较慢的 Java 或 .NET 服务。它能在应用尚未完全启动时屏蔽 liveness/readiness 的误杀，特别适用于类路径庞大、预热时间较长、需要加载缓存或执行数据库迁移的服务。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/readiness
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 30

Deployment.description: 启动探针失败阈值。对于启动慢的 Java、.NET 或大型缓存服务，这个值决定了冷启动窗口长度，应根据实际启动耗时留足缓冲。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:

spec:

    metadata:

    spec:

        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/readiness
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 30

Deployment.description: 存活探针用于判断进程是否已进入不可恢复状态。Spring Boot 建议接入 Actuator 的 /actuator/health/liveness，避免把数据库瞬时抖动或下游依赖异常误判为容器死亡。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/liveness
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3

Deployment.description: 存活探针首次延迟时间。设置过短容易在应用冷启动、JIT 预热、缓存加载或数据库连接初始化阶段误杀容器。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service

spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/liveness
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3

Deployment.description: 就绪探针决定 Pod 是否参与 Service 负载均衡。微服务生产场景建议指向 /actuator/health/readiness，只有当线程池、连接池、缓存和核心依赖均可服务时再放量，防止冷启动流量直接打满新实例。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:

spec:

Deployment.description: 连续成功阈值。多数场景保持 1 即可；对偶发抖动较多、刚上线后短时间内可能 Ready/NotReady 波动的服务，可适当提高做去抖。
Deployment.demo:

Deployment.description: 容器级安全上下文。建议对普通微服务显式关闭提权、启用非 root 运行、去除 Linux capabilities，并配合只读根文件系统降低攻击面。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: account-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: account-service
          image: registry.example.com/iam/account-service:2.4.8
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

Deployment.description: 只读根文件系统。适合大多数 12-factor 微服务，可迫使应用把临时文件写到 `emptyDir`、`/tmp` 或显式挂载目录中，减少运行时篡改风险。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: account-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
    spec:
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
      containers:
        - name: account-service
          image: registry.example.com/iam/account-service:2.4.8
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp

Deployment.description: Pod 级卷定义。微服务生产实践中常把 application.yml、logback-spring.xml、信任证书链等通过 ConfigMap 或 Secret 以文件形式挂载，便于与应用默认配置区分，同时减少重建镜像次数。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: order-service
          image: registry.example.com/commerce/order-service:1.18.6
          volumeMounts:
            - name: app-config
              mountPath: /app/config/application.yml
              subPath: application.yml
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: app-config
          configMap:
            name: order-service-config
            items:
              - key: application.yml
                path: application.yml

Deployment.description: 临时目录卷。适合缓存临时文件、解压产物、只读根文件系统场景下的 `/tmp` 或运行时工作目录，它的生命周期与 Pod 一致。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: account-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: account-service
    spec:
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
      containers:
        - name: account-service
          image: registry.example.com/iam/account-service:2.4.8
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp

Deployment.description: 引用现有 PVC。适合无状态服务少量持久化需求，如本地缓存、离线包、共享素材目录等，但要确认并发访问模式与生命周期设计。
Deployment.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: report-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: report-service
    spec:
      volumes:
        - name: report-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: report-shared-pvc
      containers:
        - name: report-service
          image: registry.example.com/report/report-service:4.6.1
          volumeMounts:
            - name: report-data
              mountPath: /data/report

Service.description: Service 注解。LoadBalancer 或云平台集成场景中，常通过 annotations 指定内网/公网、LB 类型、健康检查、代理协议等能力。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-gateway
  namespace: prod
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-internal: "true"
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-gateway
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

Service.description: Service 类型。集群内部服务默认使用 ClusterIP；若需要在边缘节点直接暴露端口，可使用 NodePort，但生产更推荐通过 Ingress 或云厂商负载均衡统一接入，减少暴露面。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP

Service.description: ExternalName 类型服务指向的外部域名。适合把集群外的 SaaS、托管数据库或遗留 HTTP 服务纳入统一服务发现，但它不提供端口转发与健康检查。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: fraud-api-external
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ExternalName
  externalName: fraud-api.external.example.com

Service.description: 指定由哪类负载均衡实现处理该 Service。生产多 LB 控制器共存时很有用，例如同时存在云厂商 LB 和自建 BGP LB 时进行精确选择。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-gateway
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  loadBalancerClass: service.k8s.aws/nlb
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-gateway
  ports:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      targetPort: https

Service.description: ClusterIP 为 Service 的虚拟访问地址；当设置为 None 时表示 Headless Service，常用于 StatefulSet 让客户端直接感知到各个 Pod 的稳定 DNS 名称，例如 redis-cluster-0.redis-cluster-headless.prod.svc。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cluster-headless
  namespace: prod
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  publishNotReadyAddresses: true
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: redis

Service.description: 是否把未 Ready 的 Pod 地址也发布到 Endpoints。通常与 Headless Service 配合 StatefulSet 使用，便于 Redis、Kafka、ZooKeeper 等在初始化阶段完成成员发现。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cluster-headless
  namespace: prod
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  publishNotReadyAddresses: true
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: redis

Service.description: 双栈策略。对同时支持 IPv4 与 IPv6 的集群，可使用 PreferDualStack 或 RequireDualStack；若业务和基础设施仍以 IPv4 为主，则保持 SingleStack 更稳妥。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ipFamilyPolicy: PreferDualStack
  ipFamilies:
    - IPv4
    - IPv6
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

Service.description: 显式声明 IP 协议族顺序。在双栈集群中，这能帮助平台决定主族与次族；如果网络设备、WAF 或客户端尚未完全支持 IPv6，建议优先 IPv4。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  ipFamilyPolicy: PreferDualStack
  ipFamilies:
    - IPv4
    - IPv6
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

Service.description: Service 通过 selector 选择后端 Pod。生产上必须与 Deployment 或 StatefulSet 的稳定标签精确对齐，避免把灰度、Job 或其它环境的 Pod 误纳入流量池。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    app.kubernetes.io/component: api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

Service.description: 会话亲和性。对于登录态仍依赖内存会话、WebSocket 长连接或短时间内需要访问本地缓存的应用，可启用 ClientIP 保持一段时间的会话粘性，但更推荐业务层无状态化。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: checkout-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  sessionAffinity: ClientIP
  sessionAffinityConfig:
    clientIP:
      timeoutSeconds: 10800
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout-service
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

Service.description: ClientIP 会话保持时间，单位秒。时间过短会导致频繁换 Pod，过长则可能让热点用户长期粘在单实例上；生产常按 30 分钟到 3 小时结合业务会话时长来配置。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: checkout-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  sessionAffinity: ClientIP
  sessionAffinityConfig:
    clientIP:
      timeoutSeconds: 3600
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: checkout-service
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

Service.description: NodePort 或 LoadBalancer 的外部流量策略。若需要保留真实客户端源 IP 用于审计、风控或限流，可设为 Local；但要确保每个接入节点上都有健康后端，否则会出现部分节点丢流量。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-gateway
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: NodePort
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-gateway
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      nodePort: 32080
    - name: https
      port: 443
      targetPort: https
      nodePort: 32443

Service.description: 集群内部流量策略。设置为 Local 时，Pod 会优先访问本节点上的后端，适合日志、监控代理、节点本地缓存等场景，可降低跨节点网络开销；业务服务使用前要先评估节点上副本分布是否均衡。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: log-agent
  namespace: observability
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  internalTrafficPolicy: Local
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: log-agent
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 2020
      targetPort: http

Service.description: 把外部静态 IP 绑定到 Service。适合特殊网络架构或传统设备路由接入，但要同步确认上游交换机、ARP、路由和安全策略，避免黑洞流量。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: legacy-gateway
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  externalIPs:
    - 10.20.30.40
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: legacy-gateway
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http

Service.description: 限制可访问 LoadBalancer 的来源网段。公网暴露接口建议与 WAF、堡垒机、办公网出口或专线源地址配合，避免对全网开放管理接口。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: admin-gateway
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  loadBalancerSourceRanges:
    - 203.0.113.0/24
    - 198.51.100.10/32
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: admin-gateway
  ports:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      targetPort: https

Service.description: LoadBalancer 使用 Local 流量策略时的健康检查端口。部分云厂商会要求显式保留该端口用于探测节点本地是否存在健康后端。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-gateway
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  healthCheckNodePort: 32081
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: edge-gateway
  ports:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      targetPort: https

Service.description: 是否为 LoadBalancer 自动分配 NodePort。若当前云负载均衡实现并不依赖 NodePort，可关闭该选项以减少额外暴露端口。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: internal-api
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  allocateLoadBalancerNodePorts: false
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: internal-api
  ports:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      targetPort: https

Service.description: 服务端口列表。生产建议为端口命名并区分 http、grpc、metrics 等协议；targetPort 优先引用容器端口名而不是硬编码数字，减少应用端口调整时联动修改的风险。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
      appProtocol: http
    - name: metrics
      port: 9090
      targetPort: metrics
      protocol: TCP
      appProtocol: http

Service.description: 应用层协议提示。虽然多数核心转发逻辑仍由 port/protocol 决定，但 appProtocol 对网关、服务网格、平台识别 HTTP 或 gRPC 更友好。
Service.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: payment-grpc
  namespace: prod
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: payment-grpc
  ports:
    - name: grpc
      port: 9090
      targetPort: grpc
      protocol: TCP
      appProtocol: grpc

Ingress.description: Nginx Ingress 的跨域控制。生产上不要简单使用通配符 *，应明确 allow-origin、allow-methods、allow-headers 与 credentials 策略，防止浏览器端越权访问。
Ingress.demo:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: portal-api
  namespace: prod
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/enable-cors: 'true'
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/cors-allow-origin: 'https://portal.example.com,https://admin.example.com'
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/cors-allow-methods: 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/cors-allow-headers: 'Authorization,Content-Type,X-Request-ID'

Ingress.description: 与上游服务建立连接的超时时间。对于连接池紧张、网络链路复杂或跨网段访问的后端，应避免设置过低以导致偶发 504。

Ingress.description: 基于源地址白名单限制访问。适合仅开放给办公网、堡垒机、专线出口或管理平台的后台接口，比应用层名单更早拦截请求。

ConfigMap.description: ConfigMap 注解。适合记录配置版本、变更批次、配置来源系统或 Git 提交号，便于排查配置漂移和回溯发布。

metadata:

  namespace: prod
immutable: true
data:

ConfigMap.description: 通过 Pod 卷挂载 ConfigMap。适合 application.yml、证书信任链、模板文件等以文件形式读取的配置，且对 Java 应用更友好，因为 Spring Boot 可以直接从固定路径加载外部配置文件。

ConfigMap.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-service
  namespace: prod
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: order-service
    spec:
      volumes:

            name: order-service-config

PVC.description: PVC 注解。可用于记录归档等级、备份策略、数据保留周期或平台自动化标记，方便存储运维和成本治理。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: audit-log-pvc
  namespace: prod
  annotations:
    storage.platform.example.com/tier: "hot"
    storage.platform.example.com/retention: "180d"
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 500Gi
  storageClassName: csi-ssd

PVC.description: 访问模式决定卷如何被挂载。生产最常见的是 ReadWriteOnce；如果业务需要多副本共享同一卷，应确认底层存储是否真正支持 ReadWriteMany，而不是只在 YAML 中写上一个看似可用的模式。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: audit-log-pvc
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 100Gi
  storageClassName: csi-ssd

PVC.description: PVC 申请的容量大小。生产容量规划不应只看当前数据量，还要考虑峰值增长、保留周期、压缩率与扩容窗口；若依赖动态扩容，还需确保 StorageClass 开启 allowVolumeExpansion。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: audit-log-pvc
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 500Gi
  storageClassName: csi-ssd

PVC.description: StorageClass 决定底层存储类型、性能级别与回收策略。生产应根据业务特征选择 SSD、吞吐优化盘或高可用盘，并区分数据库、日志、缓存、归档等不同场景。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: mysql-data
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 200Gi
  storageClassName: csi-high-iops

PVC.description: 卷模式。大多数微服务和中间件使用 Filesystem；只有对裸块设备有明确需求时才使用 Block，例如某些数据库或高性能存储场景。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: kafka-data
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  volumeMode: Filesystem
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Ti
  storageClassName: csi-ssd

PVC.description: PVC 通过标签选择器绑定现有 PV。适合接管历史卷、手工导入外部存储或特定合规分区，但要确保 selector 与 volumeName、storageClass 策略一致。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: legacy-order-archive
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      storage-role: archive
      app: order
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 2Ti
  storageClassName: ""

PVC.description: 从 VolumeSnapshot 或现有 PVC 恢复数据。生产中常用于演练恢复、搭建只读分析副本或故障回滚，前提是 CSI 驱动和快照 CRD 已正确安装并验证过恢复链路。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: audit-log-restore
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: csi-ssd
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 500Gi
  dataSource:
    name: audit-log-snap-20260328
    kind: VolumeSnapshot
    apiGroup: snapshot.storage.k8s.io

PVC.description: 更通用的数据来源引用。相比 dataSource，它对更多自定义数据源和未来扩展更友好；是否可用取决于集群版本与 CSI 驱动能力。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: mysql-restore
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: csi-high-iops
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 200Gi
  dataSourceRef:
    apiGroup: snapshot.storage.k8s.io
    kind: VolumeSnapshot
    name: mysql-snap-20260328

PVC.description: 显式绑定到某个预创建的 PV。适用于手工接管已有存储、迁移历史数据或对接外部预置磁盘的场景；使用时要同步确认 PV 的 reclaimPolicy、容量和访问模式是否匹配。
PVC.demo:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: legacy-order-archive
  namespace: prod
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 2Ti
  volumeName: pv-order-archive-001
  storageClassName: ''

kind: StatefulSet
metadata:

  namespace: prod
spec:

        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster

kind: StatefulSet
metadata:

    spec:

StatefulSet.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-cluster
  namespace: prod
spec:
  serviceName: redis-cluster-headless
  podManagementPolicy: Parallel
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: registry.example.com/middleware/redis:7.2.5-1

StatefulSet.description: StatefulSet 的更新策略。RollingUpdate 支持按序滚动更新，partition 可以保留部分旧实例，适合对状态节点分批灰度；关键中间件升级前仍建议先做快照、备份和只读切换预案。
StatefulSet.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-cluster
  namespace: prod
spec:
  serviceName: redis-cluster-headless
  replicas: 3
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: registry.example.com/middleware/redis:7.2.5-1

StatefulSet.description: 保留历史版本数量。对中间件升级回滚很重要，但也应控制数量，避免状态类应用积累过多历史版本带来排障复杂度。
StatefulSet.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-cluster
  namespace: prod
spec:
  serviceName: redis-cluster-headless
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cluster

StatefulSet.description: 最小就绪时间。对有状态组件很有价值，因为某些实例刚通过就绪探针并不代表已经完成同步或稳定对外服务，可留出额外观察窗口。
StatefulSet.demo:
apiVersion: apps/v1
